_note: Cycle narrative of the multicycle view (spec WS-U-031, in the manner of WS-F-033). Written afresh for the simulator (C4) in the register-transfer notation of Chapter 7 (sec:mc-steps): R[n] a register, M[a] a memory word, imm the sign-extended immediate, <- (shown as an arrow) a transfer at the edge that ends the step. Each state lists the transfers that a later step uses, as the chapter does; rs1_q, rs2_q, alu_q and mdr are in fact loaded at every edge. Status: approved by the author on 2026-10-26. Placeholders in braces are filled by src/ui/multi-view.js; {alu_sym} and {alu_val} use alu_expr of narrative-ch06.json.

DECODE.rtn: alu_q ← instr_pc + imm (the target, if this is a branch or jal)

BRANCH.val_not: {cond_val} does not hold: the PC keeps {pc}

JALR.rtn: R[rd] ← PC (the link: PC already holds instr_pc + 4)
alu_q ← rs1_q + imm (the target; JAL then loads it into the PC, bit 0 cleared)

x0: rd is x0: the register file discards the write, and x0 stays 0.
halt: FETCH reads jal x0, 0, the halt instruction: the program ends here, and this cycle is not executed.
